info.title: MutaMarket API
info.description:
Public API for abyssal modules in EVE Online: browse what is for sale, look up a single module with every rolled attribute and its estimated value, import a module from EVE, and read the reference data behind the roll-quality metrics.

No key or account is needed. Send a User-Agent that identifies you, with a contact address. Do not call POST /modules in a loop: it calls EVE's ESI and runs a price model on every request.

Only the endpoints described here are public. Everything else under /api serves mutamarket.com itself and changes without notice.

get.description: The best and worst possible rolled value of every mutated attribute of every abyssal type. This is the data behind the fraction_type roll-quality metric and the attribute bars.

200.description: One entry per type and attribute.

get.description: How much data each per-type price model was trained on, how well it fits, and its average error. A null r2 means the model is untrained and modules of that type carry no estimate.

get.summary: Always rejects: the list needs a type
get.description: The list requires a type option, so this always answers 404.

404.description: The list requires a type option.

post.description: Fetches the module live from ESI and runs the value estimation synchronously, so expect a few seconds. Re-submitting an existing module refreshes it. Do not call this in a loop.

400.description: The import failed, or the request carried no usable item link.

422.description: Neither a message nor both ids were given. `message` repeats the first failing field, in the order message, item_id, type_id.

get.summary: List modules of a type, or get one module
get.description:
A path segment ending in digits is read as a single-module lookup by EVE item id or MutaMarket slug. Anything else is the type-scoped list, whose segments carry the filter and sort options documented at https://mutamarket.com/documentation/api-modules.

The list requires a type option, e.g. `type/49738` or `type/abyssal-ballistic-control-system`.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Either a module item id or slug, or a type segment plus filter and sort segments.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from meta.next_cursor of a previous response. List responses only.

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description: Only modules whose contract is in this EVE region. List responses only.

200.description: One module, or a page of them.

404.description: No such module, or the query named no valid abyssal type.

example.message: No module with this item id is known to MutaMarket.

AbyssalTypeStatistic.description: The roll extremes of one attribute of one abyssal type.

high_is_good.description: Whether a larger value is better. When false, `best` is smaller.

is_derived.description: Computed by MutaMarket rather than rolled by EVE.

ApiError.description: Every error response of the public API.

AssetLocationView.description:
Where a user's module physically sits, the legacy `AssetResource`
shape: the direct parent (ship/container, or the station itself when the
module lies loose in a hangar) plus the resolved station/structure at
the top of the ancestor chain.

owner.description:
The character holding the asset (legacy `asset.character`, loaded
by `withUserAsset`); the find-asset card names them.

oneOf.description: The station or structure hosting the chain (legacy `station` key).

ContractRef.description:
Legacy `ContractResource` as loaded for a module's latest public
contract (issuer loaded; modules/types/acceptor/status absent for
public contracts).

price.description: The unified price (auction bids and asked-for PLEX included).

EstimatorStatistic.description: Quality metrics of one per-type price model.

data_count.description: Recorded sales the model was trained on.

data_statistics.description: Training sales by the source module's meta group.

nmae.description: Mean absolute error normalized by the mean sale price.

r2.description:
Fit against the training data, 1 being perfect. Null means the
model is untrained, and modules of the type carry no estimate.

item_id.description: EVE item id of the module.

message.description:
Any string containing `showinfo:{type_id}//{item_id}`, such as an
in-game item link copied out of chat.

type_id.description: EVE type id of the mutated module.

ModuleAttributeView.description:
Legacy `MutatedAttributeResource`, plus the server-computed `type_band`
the legacy frontend derives from its bundled static data.

type_band.description:
The mutaplasmid's own share of the type-wide roll range, as (min,
max) half-width fractions — the highlight band of the
type-normalized bar. Absent when the mutaplasmid covers the whole
range.

ModuleDetail.description:
A module as the legacy `ModuleResource` emits it for guests with the
default relations loaded: same field names, same nesting. Keys owned by
unported features (`contract`, `public_asset`, estimator values) are
present and null, like the legacy loaded-but-empty relations.

oneOf.description:
Where the module sits in the signed-in user's assets (the legacy
`withUserAsset` half of `withDefaultRelations`, loaded on every
module list): present-and-null when they do not own it, absent
for guests.

The per-collection note (legacy `withCollectionNote`): present for
every viewer of a collection page, absent elsewhere.
The module's latest public sale contract, if any.

The signed-in user's note (legacy `withUserNote` in the default
relations): the key exists only with a session, and is null when
the user has no note on the module. Absent for guests.

public_asset.description: The MutaMarket sell listing; arrives with the assets milestone.

oneOf.description:
The recorded historic sale (legacy `whenLoaded('trainingModule')`):
present only on the historic-sales cards, absent elsewhere.

ModuleOrPage.description:
One module when the path segment is an id or slug, a page of them when
it is a type-scoped query.

NoteCollectionRef.description:
Legacy `CollectionResource` as embedded in a collection note: only the
collection's own columns (no counted or loaded relations).

PageLinks.description: `first` and `last` are always null on a cursor paginator.

next_cursor.description: Opaque. Pass it back as the `cursor` query parameter.

SourceTypeRef.description:
Legacy `TypeResource` as loaded for the source type (meta group loaded,
type attributes and meta level not).

StatisticAttribute.description:
The dogma attribute of a roll range. `high_is_good` and `is_derived`
repeat the parent's values.

errors.description: Field name to the messages for that field.
